ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: According to the given food chain, what type of organism is the razor clam?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The title in the figure is “MARINE FOOD WEB”. At the bottom of the food web there is “Plankton”, and an arrow points upward from Plankton to “Razor Clam”. This indicates that energy or food is transferred from plankton to the razor clam. Reasoning: Arrows in a food chain usually point from the food being eaten to the organism that eats it. The razor clam directly eats plankton located at the bottom of the food chain, so it belongs to consumers that eat producers or bottom-level organisms, that is, primary consumers.
